Order

1.

The present petition is filed under section 482 Cr.P.C. for quashing of FIR bearing no.0908/2014 dated 20.10.2014 registered under sections 34/406/498A IPC at P.S. Amar Colony along with consequential proceedings.
2. The petitioner no.1 and the respondent no.2 got married on 18.02.2011 at Haridwar according to Hindu rites and ceremonies and no child was born out of their marriage.

The petitioner no.1 and the respondent no.2 due to matrimonial differences started to live separately since October, 2013,
without any cohabitation.
3. The respondent no.2 got registered present FIR bearing no. 0908/2014 This is a digitally signed order.

The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 21/10/2023 at 23:50:40 dated 20.10.2014 under sections 34/406/498A IPC at P.S. Amar Colony wherein the petitioners were implicated.
The petitioner nos. 2 to 7 are the family members/relatives of the petitioner no. 1.
The petitioners and the respondent no. 2 are identified by the Investigating Officer SI Pradeep Sharma, P.S Amar Colony as well as by their respective counsel.

1 respondent no.2 appeared through video conferencing.

The marriage between the petitioner no.1 and the respondent no. 2 has already been dissolved by Divorce Order in the Federal Circuit Court of Australia on 01.03.2015.
4.

The counsel for the petitioners and the respondent no.2 stated that they have settled their disputes and the marriage between the petitioner no.1 and the respondent no.2 has already been dissolved by way of Divorce Order in the Federal Circuit Court of Australia on 01.03.2015 as such the present petition be allowed and FIR bearing no. 0908/2014 registered under sections 34/406/498A IPC at P.S. Amar Colony be quashed.
5. The respondent no.2 stated that she does not want to pursue the proceedings arising out of FIR bearing no.0908/2014 as she has already settled in her life after divorce from the petitioner no.1.

The respondent no.2 stated that she does not have any objection if the present petition is allowed and FIR bearing no. 0908/2014 registered under sections 34/406/498A IPC at P.S. Amar Colony is quashed.

6. The Additional Public Prosecutor for the respondent no.1/State stated that as the petitioner no.1 and the respondent no.2 have already settled their disputes amicably, as such he does not have any objection if the present FIR bearing no. 0908/2014 registered under sections 34/406/498A IPC at P.S. Amar Colony is quashed.
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 21/10/2023 at 23:50:40 7.
The petitioner no.1 and the respondent no. 2 got married on 18.02.2011 and due to matrimonial differences, they are living separately since October, 2013 without any cohabitation.

The petitioner no.1 and the respondent no.2 have already settled their disputes and the marriage between the petitioner no.1 and the respondent no.2 has already been dissolved by way of Divorce Order in the Federal Circuit Court of Australia on 01.03.2015 as detailed hereinabove.

No useful purpose shall be served if the proceedings arising out of FIR bearing no. 0908/2014 are allowed to be continued and it would be an exercise in futility.
8.

After considering all facts, the present petition is allowed and FIR bearing no. 0908/2014 dated 20.10.2014 registered under sections 34/406/498A IPC at P.S. Amar Colony along with consequential proceedings is quashed.
9. Accordingly, the present petition stands disposed of.
DR. SUDHIR KUMAR JAIN, J OCTOBER 18, 2023/j/ak
